research_question: Do original source-only NR-M2B factor-cells select short synthetic public-goal actions and predict eight-step consequences better than equally trained unchanged R7 under EXACT SAME authored feedback and search budget?
source: Existing authored public 8-bit action-conditioned nonlinear effect truth(seed 11/12) from R7; no original environment/reset/step, hidden private world, FSA cohort or new source family.

cohorts.training: 192 distinct authored public before/action/after events per 3 actions for each regime; factor trained via explicit selected-source API; R7 trained independently on identical effects and 3-of-8 parent structural prior; no data from 64 withheld input states per regime
cohorts.test: first 16 sorted public states excluded from 192 training states for each seed
cohorts.goal_construction: for each of 16 withheld states two public goals computed using evaluator-only true five-action sequences [0,1,2,0,1] and [2,1,0,2,1]; planner sees ONLY public start, public goal, learned model/transition callback; goal derivation actions never shown to model
cohorts.task_count: 2 regimes x 16 public starts x 2 goals = 64 authored source-only tasks
cohorts.long_horizon: 64 withheld public starts x 2 regimes = 128 exact eight-action chain forecasts; fixed action sequence [0,2,1,0,1,2,0,2]

controls: Strong unchanged original Yggdrasil R7, fully trained separately with all same 576 public effects per regime, same three-parent structural hypothesis
Exact-(before,action) categorical count memory from same 576 public effects, sufficient only if exact public state/action has been actually observed (otherwise abstain)
Untrained no-memory ablation, abstains on all transitions
planner: Identical deterministic breadth-first search for every predictive arm, actions 0,1,2 in order, public state graph visited once, maximum 5 actions and 364 expanded nodes. Unknown model transition is never given fallback/oracle, action plan abstains. No planner sees evaluator original causal truth except synthetic public goal bit value.
outcomes: number of source-free synthetic plans returned; fraction reaching public goal when executed by test-only authored source truth; selected action count and length versus strongest R7; 8-step prediction successes and abstentions; model/control action disagreement; exact-state/no-memory abstention counts; per-arm process CPU nanoseconds, wall time ns, Python tracemalloc peak allocation approximate; checkpoint bytes and 576 selected events (and inherited original base separately)
negative_stop: If R7 matches or outperforms candidate in public goal success, action count and long predictions, science result NO_UNIQUE_ADVANTAGE. This must not be called real policy improvement. If candidate goals fail or cannot support complete synthetic 8-step, engineering FAIL; do not tune the fixture after results.
qualification: Source-only Linux+Windows tests, exact source identities, standard FORGE full regression independently required. Store run result in GitHub Actions uploaded artifact and repository advisory comment; no native code integration, merge or promotion.
authority: No original Farama/Pycolab environment, FSA first use, hidden evaluator lookup in policy, accepted registry/controller/queue or source owning native source mutation. Main research PR remains DRAFT.
